_comment: Steps OCILB/CSLB/DBPR apply to HVAC and plumbing applicants alike, shown once on /state/florida. Each item names the registered documents that contain it. replacesSteps: the verbatim record steps these stand in for (kept off the summary pages).

items.text: Pay the $350 Endorsement application fee to the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation.
Submit electronic fingerprints, a FICO-derived credit report, and proof of satisfaction of any liens, judgments, or bankruptcy.
